title: Hold a racing bookmaker's licence
what: Carry on bookmaking at a licensed race venue only as a licensed racing bookmaker, and away from the course only under an off-course approval at an approved place.

sources.title: Racing Integrity Act 2016 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on bookmaking for a code of racing at any time at a licensed venue unless— (a) the person is a racing bookmaker for the code of racing

sources.title: Racing Integrity Act 2016 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on bookmaking at a place unless— (a) the person is a racing bookmaker who holds an offcourse approval for carrying on bookmaking at an approved place
